posts.name: Krishna Sai
posts.cooked:
I am unable to login to VM for NPPE (OPPE Practice problems)

I am using the ssh <roll_no>@sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in (I have access to VM, but I cannot see the NPPE problems at /opt/se2001), it is giving the error “<roll_no>@sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in: Permission denied (publickey).“

I have tried using the passwordless access again, but still the new generated public key is giving me access to the VM, but the NPPE SSH.

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked:
For the oppe vm, you have to update your ssh on this site : https://vm-manager-se2001-oppe-781744309994.asia-south1.run.app/

This link is different from the vm you use for BPTs.

posts.name: Ankita venkatesh
posts.cooked: I have login the oppe vm https://vm-manager-se2001-oppe-781744309994.asia-south1.run.app/ but still I’m getting the permission denied

posts.name: Prakhar Arora
posts.cooked:
Dear student,

What do you mean by the following:

24f2007425:

I have access to VM

and

24f2007425:

it is giving the error “<roll_no>@sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in: Permission denied (publickey).“

The second line means that “YOU HAVE NOT ENTERED THE VIRTUAL MACHINE.”

Please check what is the actual problem and then post it here, we will guide you.

Thank you
Prakhar Arora
Teaching Assistant for System Commands

posts.name: Ankita venkatesh
posts.cooked: @22f3000671 I have followed all the instructions correctly to generate the SSH key pair and have added the public key to the authorized keys on the server. when i tried attempting to log in to the vm. I am still encountering the error: ‘Permission denied (publickey).’ Kindly assist in resolving this authentication issue.

posts.name: Krishna Sai
posts.cooked:
Should I access NPPE from VM or SSH from my command window, because I can SSH to VM from my command window.

SSH Commands

ssh <roll_no>@ds.study.iitm.ac.in - For VM

ssh <roll_no>@sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in - For NPPE

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
24f2007425:

ssh <roll_no>@ds.study.iitm.ac.in - For VM

This is not even the correct domain!

You do both from your local system, same way, just different domain. You DO NOT DO THIS:

local → Course VM → NPPE VM

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Join the oppe support session at 9 pm and get your issue resolved.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Follow what Sayan said. If you are unable to login kindly join the OPPE support meet at 9 pm. @24f2007425

posts.name: SAVARIO SALET SUJITHRA
posts.cooked: I can join to oppe-vm and view nppe questions.but my existing VM login for BPT got denied , the existing keys are overwritten.what I can do now?

posts.name: Prakhar Arora
posts.cooked:
Dear student,

Copy the newly created public key, and post it in the COURSE VM passwordless website. Then you can login to both Course VM and OPPE VM with the same key.

Thank you
Prakhar Arora
Teaching Assistant for System Commands
